Name: (CP) Better Bridges
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]
I always thought the bridges in Stardew Valley looked awful. They're just worn-out planks with nails. I mean, seriously, you make millions on a farm and you're still walking on worn-out wooden planks?[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]There are two versions of this mod:
[color=#f1c232]Improved Farm Bridges[/color]: Once you upgrade your farmhouse, all bridges will also be upgraded (if there are any).

[color=#f1c232]Improved Bridges[/color]: Automatically upgrades ALL bridges in the game, including bridges in Cindersap Forest, the mountain, etc.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000]This mod does not support recolors (Earty, Starblue, etc.). However, the designs are free to use for anyone to create their own recolors.[/color][/center]

Downloads.Description: This version is exclusive to farms; upgrade your house once and your bridges will be upgraded.
